items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: Camille Robinson, we used to all have a little band and spot here and there.

ctx.x: Did you play with Red Dallin in the old days too, around here?

Well, during the time he was down there playing, his dad was strict on him. He used to play, he had his band. I used to spot a different band, Walter, Albert Wallace, and Camille Robinson, we used to all have a little band and spot here and there. That's when Allen was here, that's years ago when he was young, we was all young fellas there. I never played with him, but I have played with him recently.
I'd like to ask you about that, you said you had a banjo band with, Sales was in it?
